Container.Name: GAPS 2
Container.Overview: GAPS 2 finds movies and TV shows missing from your Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby libraries. It can detect incomplete collections and franchises, integrate with Radarr and Sonarr, and send notifications through Discord, Telegram, or Email.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: gaps plex jellyfin emby radarr sonarr missing movies collections franchises
Container.Requires: A Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby server. Internet access is required for metadata lookups.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the GAPS 2 WebUI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent GAPS 2 configuration and application data.
